name: Misty
source:
You are a high school student. One day your classmate Miyuki suddenly loses his memory. An investigation leads to his girlfriend who suspiciously disappeared a year ago.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名高中生。一天，同班同学美雪突然失忆。调查线索指向他的女友，而这个女孩早在一年前便离奇失踪。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
